language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language of the app interface.

profile.title: Profile photo
profile.subtitle: Choose a photo that will appear in the app menu.

notif.title: Push notifications
notif.subtitle: Get reminders for your appointments directly on this device, even when the app is closed.
notif.unsupported: Notifications are not supported on this browser.
notif.denied: Permission denied. Allow notifications in your browser settings.

currency.title: Currency
currency.subtitle: Select the currency used to display amounts in your app.

modules.title: Modules
modules.subtitle: Enable or hide optional modules to keep only the ones your family uses.
modules.parentOnly: Only parents can change the modules.

descriptions.budget: Family budget tracking, expenses and income.
descriptions.integrations: Connections to third-party services (Mealie, Home Assistant…).
descriptions.kiosk: Full-screen display for a shared home screen.
descriptions.notes: Sticky notes shown on the dashboard.
descriptions.ai: Smart assistant to quickly capture and organize.

export.title: Export data
export.subtitle: Download a portable JSON copy of your family data and family-wide preferences. Authentication credentials, integration secrets, notifications, and temporary security data are not included.

import.title: Import data
import.subtitle: Restore an Family Hub portable export. Existing records are kept and duplicates are skipped; family-wide preferences from the file are restored.

regional.title: Week
regional.subtitle: Choose which day your weeks start on, in the calendar, the planning, meals and the dashboard. This setting is yours alone.
regional.weekStartHelp: Automatic follows the conventions of your language and region.

signIn.title: Sign-in
signIn.subtitle: Sign out of this device or of every device. Family Hub signs in with your email and password.
signIn.logoutDesc: Sign out of this device. Your other devices stay signed in.
signIn.logoutEverywhereDesc: Lost a phone, or signed in on a shared computer? This signs you out everywhere, including here.
signIn.confirmLogoutEverywhere: Sign out of all devices, including this one?

you.title: You
you.summary: Name, menu order, language, notifications, sign-in
you.intro: Only affects your account and this device.

household.title: Household
household.summary: Members, calendar events, shopping lists, modules, AI assistant
household.intro: Changes here apply to everyone in the family.
household.membersHelp: Parents manage settings and approve chores.

display.title: Display
display.summary: Layout, weather, night mode, frames, photos
display.intro: What the kitchen frame shows. The frame itself stays read-only.

data.title: Data
data.intro: Portable JSON. Passwords and secrets are never included.

agents.title: Agents
agents.summary: Connected apps, their keys and recent changes
agents.intro: Apps that act for your family. Parents only.

agents.title: Connected apps
agents.help: Tools outside Family Hub, such as an assistant you message, sign in here with their own key. Each one reaches only what you tick, acts as the parent who connected it, and can be removed at any time.
agents.loadFailed: Connected apps could not be loaded.

status.signed-out: Stopped: the parent who connected it signed out everywhere

agents.rotateConfirm: Make a new key? The current key stops working at once.
agents.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? It stops working at once.

form.title: Connect an app
form.name: Name
form.namePlaceholder: For example: Assistant on the Mac
form.readHelp: Tick only what this app needs. New features inside a ticked area are included.
form.writeHelp: Each change it makes or tries is listed under Recent changes.
form.limit: You have the most apps Family Hub allows ({{max}}). Remove one to connect another.

token.title: Key for {{name}}
token.help: Copy this key into the app now. Family Hub does not keep it and cannot show it again; if it is lost, make a new key.

area.overview: Home overview: today's calendar, to-dos and notes

record.title: Recent changes
record.help: Every change a connected app made or tried, newest first. Kept for 90 days.
record.loadFailed: Recent changes could not be loaded.

agents.error: That did not work. Try again.

calendarEvents.title: Calendar events
calendarEvents.connect: Connect Google and choose the shared calendar first (Home → Google).
calendarEvents.lengthHelp: Used when an event is added without an end time, for example by the AI assistant, and to fill in the end in the event form.
calendarEvents.googleUnknown: Uses the notification set for the calendar in Google Calendar.
calendarEvents.googleNone: Google Calendar has no default notification set, so new events get none.
calendarEvents.googleCalendar: Now: {{when}} before, from the shared calendar's settings in Google Calendar.
calendarEvents.googleMain: Now: {{when}} before, from your main calendar in Google Calendar (the shared calendar has no default of its own).
calendarEvents.reminderHelp: Applies to timed events created from Family Hub, the AI assistant and connected apps. All-day events keep Google's own setting. Notifications are personal in Google: they show for the connected account.
